source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: As the opponent’s [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) ends, the Defiler can pick an enemy that arrived on the battlefield that phase within 12″ of it. It may shoot at that unit as its sole eligible target, or try to charge it. It must finish a charge against that enemy unit. A successful roll grants no Charge Bonus to the Defiler’s unit that turn.
